patches.scope: Only AV_EF_EXPLODE callers: reject child-box clamping and parser overreads; reject STCO/STSC/STSZ/STTS/CTTS counts whose physical payload cannot fit; propagate STSZ short-read failure; reject STSZ/TRUN sample-index expansion above a nonzero max_index_size before allocation.
patches.compatibility: Default playback repair and all codec/encoder implementations stay unchanged. Strict clients must explicitly configure max_index_size; the upstream default was not designed as a complete required-index budget.
patches.limits: This is not an OS memory limit or a proof that every MOV metadata type and decoder allocation is bounded. Complete real-file tests and additional resource review remain necessary.
patches.localVerification: Forward and reverse git apply --check succeeded against copies whose original Git blob exactly matches the fixed source. Native compile/runtime not yet run when this record was created.

beforeEvidence.finding: Unpatched strict-input FFmpeg accepted the real stsz-extra-entry.mp4 as 251 decoded frames; every other case matched. Shared MF full validation independently accepted four damaged audio/video cases on Windows job 139053165531.

upstreamReview.finding: The reviewed master retains child-size FFMIN recovery and successful return after the STSZ truncated warning; no equivalent strict change was found in the examined source or targeted commit searches.

relevantCommits.use: Actual diff intentionally changes a failed STSZ read into a warning and success. Strict inspection preserves the read error instead.
